As someone with survival training in the Northern Territories, and who has been injured in the woods and suffered from hypothermia, trust me, anyone who spent that much time in the water would be dead in a matter of hours. I've seen full grown, healthy, men end up with hypothermia in the middle of the summer just from the moisture off of plants after a rain the day before--staying dry and keeping your body temperature up is extremely important.
